title: Automate Yettel Zoho Platform: Connect CRM, Sales & HR #Shorts
description:
Learn how to automate sales and HR data intake in Zoho CRM for telecom subscribers. Build webforms and workflow rules with exact triggers and Zoho People integration.

1. Create a new Zoho Flow workflow triggered by inbound webhooks or ad platforms.
2. Add an AI step to parse incoming contact details and classify them as leads or HR candidates.
3. Direct qualified sales leads into Zoho CRM and HR candidate profiles into Zoho People automatically.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho CRM Upsert Leads API
- endpoint: POST https://www.zohoapis.com/crm/v6/Leads/upsert
- scope: ZohoCRM.modules.leads.CREATE
- docs: https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v6/upsert-records.html

script.title: Automate Yettel Zoho Platform: Connect CRM, Sales & HR
script.hook_text: Yettel Launches Zoho Platform for Business

lines.say: Yettel just launched the Zoho platform for business subscribers, but unintegrated apps can leave your sales and HR isolated.
lines.tts: Yettel just launched the Zoho platform for business subscribers, but unintegrated apps can leave your sales and HR isolated.

lines.say: When Yettel subscribers activate bundled Zoho access, marketing intake, sales leads, and HR onboarding remain stuck in manual silos.
lines.tts: When Yettel subscribers activate bundled Zoho access, marketing intake, sales leads, and HR onboarding remain stuck in manual silos.

lines.say: You can connect sales routing and onboarding directly inside Zoho CRM using native webforms and automated workflows.
lines.tts: You can connect sales routing and onboarding directly inside Zoho CRM using native webforms and automated workflows.

screen.heading: Webforms
screen.tip: Create webforms for inbound data intake

lines.say: First, open Setup, navigate to Channels, and click Webforms to build your automated inbound subscriber lead capture form.
lines.tts: First, open Setup, navigate to Channels, and click Webforms to build your automated inbound subscriber lead capture form.

lines.say: Next, navigate to Automation, click Workflow Rules, and click Create Rule to trigger actions on new inbound record entries.
lines.tts: Next, navigate to Automation, click Workflow Rules, and click Create Rule to trigger actions on new inbound record entries.

lines.say: Then, set the trigger to On Record Action > Create, set condition to Department equals Sales, and select Assign Owner to route leads.
lines.tts: Then, set the trigger to On Record Action, Create, set condition to Department equals Sales, and select Assign Owner to route leads.

screen.heading: Rule Details
screen.tip: Trigger On Create and assign owner for Sales

lines.say: Finally, for HR candidates, add an Instant Action using a Custom Function or Zoho Flow webhook to push data directly to Zoho People.
lines.tts: Finally, for HR candidates, add an Instant Action using a Custom Function or Zoho Flow webhook to push data directly to Zoho People.
lines.card: Action: Webhook / Function to Zoho People

screen.heading: Rule Details
screen.tip: Route HR candidates to Zoho People via Webhook or Zoho Flow

lines.say: This unifies your telecom intake, sales pipeline, and HR operations into one automated workflow.
lines.tts: This unifies your telecom intake, sales pipeline, and HR operations into one automated workflow.

test_before_recording: Verify Webforms page loads under CRM Setup > Channels > Webforms.
Ensure Create Rule dialog opens properly under CRM Setup > Automation > Workflow Rules.
Confirm Assign Owner action and Webhook/Zoho Flow action trigger correctly on record creation.
